response.text: Several findings so far. I'll check the unbalanced journals, the negative invoice, the orphan account, the unposted/period distribution, and the one fully paid open invoice.

arguments.sql: SELECT 'unbalanced' k, l."JRNL_NO"::text a, ROUND(SUM(l."DR_AMT"),2)::text b, ROUND(SUM(l."CR_AMT"),2)::text c FROM "GLJRNL" l GROUP BY l."JRNL_NO" HAVING ROUND(SUM(l."DR_AMT"),2)<>ROUND(SUM(l."CR_AMT"),2) UNION ALL SELECT 'neg_inv', "INV_ID"::text, "VEND_CD", "INV_AMT"::text FROM "APINVH" WHERE "INV_AMT"<0 UNION ALL SELECT 'orphan_acct', l."JRNL_NO"::text, l."ACCT_CD", l."LN_SEQ"::text FROM "GLJRNL" l LEFT JOIN "GLCOA" c ON c."ACCT_CD"=l."ACCT_CD" WHERE c."ACCT_CD" IS NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'posting_by_status', h."POST_FLG", h."PRD_ID"::text, COUNT(*)::text FROM "GLJRNH" h GROUP BY h."POST_FLG", h."PRD_ID" UNION ALL SELECT 'open_fully_paid', i."INV_ID"::text, i."STAT_CD", i."INV_AMT"::text FROM "APINVH" i JOIN (SELECT "INV_ID", SUM("PAY_AMT") paid FROM "APPAYM" GROUP BY "INV_ID") p ON p."INV_ID"=i."INV_ID" WHERE i."STAT_CD"='O' AND p.paid>=i."INV_AMT";
